description: This file implements OAuth provider logic for GitLab integration in Mattermost, including user data parsing, validation, and provider registration.

classes.name: GitLabUser
classes.description: Represents a GitLab user with relevant fields for OAuth integration.

methods.name: userFromGitLabUser
methods.description: Converts a GitLabUser object into a Mattermost user object, setting username, name, email, and auth data.

methods.name: gitLabUserFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a GitLabUser object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates that the GitLabUser has a non-zero ID and non-empty email.

methods.name: getAuthData
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the user's ID for authentication data.

methods.name: GetUserFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a Mattermost user from JSON data received from GitLab.

methods.name: GetSSOSettings
methods.description: Retrieves SSO settings from the configuration.

methods.name: GetUserFromIdToken
methods.description: Stub for retrieving user info from an ID token (not implemented).

methods.name: IsSameUser
methods.description: Checks if two users are the same based on their auth data.
